ValidationRule.description: Can't add product if Opportunity CloseDate is in the past
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", $Profile.Name <> "A - RevOps", $Profile.Name <> "B - Looker", $User.Alias <> 'Workato', Opportunity.CloseDate < TODAY() ) && Opportunity.Opp_Val_Bypass__c = false
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please update the Close Date as it is currently in the past.
